detail: Installs a thin GitHub Actions workflow that calls the shared Python gate in ForkHorizon/ci-gates: ruff check and ruff format --check. Uses the repo's own ruff config when present, otherwise the strict fallback config from ci-gates.

files.contents:
name: {{script_title}}

on:
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 5 * * 1"

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: python-quality-gate-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  python-quality-gate:
    uses: ForkHorizon/ci-gates/.github/workflows/python-quality.yml@main
    with:
      runs-on: '{{runner_labels_json}}'

pullRequestBody:
Adds {{script_title}} managed by CI Scope.

This PR adds:
- `.github/workflows/{{script_slug}}.yml`

The workflow calls the shared gate in `ForkHorizon/ci-gates`, so gate logic updates roll out from that repository automatically. It runs ruff lint and format checks, using the repo's own ruff config when present and a strict fallback otherwise.
summary: Runs ruff lint and format checks with a strict anti-slop fallback config.
title: Python Quality Gate
